back: Subscriptions due that members have not yet paid; a current asset.
Subscriptions paid for a later period; a current liability.
Cash received + write-offs + closing arrears + opening advance − opening arrears − closing advance.
Income, on the debit side, transferred to the income and expenditure account.

Income belongs to the year in which it is earned, not the year in which the cash is received.
